name: Complete checkout flow
description: Verifies the happy path: product page to order confirmation, including cart, shipping form and payment.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the store homepage and open the first product in the grid
Click "Add to cart" on the product page
Assert the cart badge or indicator shows a quantity of 1
Open the cart and click the "Checkout" button
Fill the shipping form with a name, email and address, then continue
Select a payment method and submit the order
Assert the order confirmation page appears with a success message and order number
